system.description: Once per rest, when an adversary inside your Surveyed Route moves within Close range or farther, you can describe how the terrain turns against them. They must make a Reaction Roll (15). On a failure, an adversary becomes temporarily Restrained, or a vehicle becomes Damaged and the they mark 1 Stress. On a success, they mark 1 Stress.
